raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the college football game between San Diego State and Oregon State, scheduled for October 10 at 6:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Oregon State" if Oregon State outscore San Diego State by 8 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "San Diego State".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
